Definition: a fulfilling (only in plural), i.e. (literally) a setting (of gems), or (technically) consecration (also concretely, a dedicatory sacrifice)
BiblicalUsage: 1) setting, installation; 1a) setting, stones for setting; 1b) installation (of priests)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
